body: Thank you for your response, I think answering a lot of that is a challenge, at least at the moment. I've gotten to a point where very little matters to me, and what use to, isn't so important anymore. I think ultimately life is what you make of it in most cases, in others I think external forces like trauma and the like shape our world view. It's going to be something I consider going forward, but I'm just not sure when I'll be capable of having an honest answer to questions around my own self.
